protocol: Single standard training exposure for each participant. The nominal chamber profile included a 20-minute 25,000-ft plateau and a brief hypoxia demonstration. Individual pressure and oxygen delivery traces are unavailable.
outcome_window: The authors report no study DCS symptoms in the chamber procedure section. A clinical case definition, ascertainment schedule and fixed duration of delayed symptom follow-up are not specified.
note: The article reports no DCS symptoms in the study. The exact exposed denominator is reconstructed from 64 men and 32 women in the post-hoc exposed group. The unexposed controls and inside safety monitors are outside this risk set. MRI timing does not establish a standardized DCS surveillance window.
